task.title: Replace the concept-1c application icon with the squircle brick-S mark the redesigned app already renders
task.objective: Regenerate resources/icon-source.png, resources/icon.png and resources/icon.ico from the AwkitDarkBrandMark geometry that the awkit-lgn2 title bar and login wordmark already use (dark squircle, brick S, accent brick), point the sidebar brand tile at the same shared component so the sidebar and the OS icon stay identical, prove build + branding/token/offline verifiers, and reconcile project state. The Login page review against the proposed Login.dc.html design is an inspect-only report delivered in chat; no login markup changes.

compatibility: The OS icon is a baked raster: the accent brick is fixed at the design-system primary accent #7c3aed (brand-600, the default --awkit-accent), while in-app marks keep following var(--awkit-accent).
The sidebar brand tile stays on the dark finish in both themes, preserving the existing sidebar-equals-OS-icon rule; the title bar keeps its theme-following light/dark marks.
The dev-only Program Status dashboard (tools/roadmap/public/index.html) keeps its inline concept-1c SVG; it is derived tooling, never bundled, and outside this task's paths.
offline: Icon generation runs locally through the already-installed sharp dependency; no new dependency, font or network access.

acceptance.description: resources/icon.ico (7 PNG frames 16-256, 32-bit RGBA) and resources/icon.png (1024 master) are regenerated from the AwkitDarkBrandMark squircle brick-S geometry and no longer show the concept-1c spectrum mark.
The sidebar brand tile renders the shared AwkitDarkBrandMark (the private concept-1c SpecterAppIcon copy is removed), the build passes and the branding, design-token and offline verifiers pass.
Project state reconciled, the awkit-icon2 bead closed and exported, roadmap reads Sources agree, and no commit or push is made without owner authority.
